body:
{
  "name": "dsh-plugin-goecs",
  "version": "0.2.29",
  "description": "Run GoECS locally or over SSH in DeepSeek Harness and read, copy or export faithful TXT, HTML, Markdown and JSON reports.",
  "type": "module",
  "license": "GPL-3.0-only",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs.git"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs#deepseek-harness-plugin",
  "keywords": [
    "dsh-plugin",
    "deepseek-harness",
    "goecs",
    "benchmark"
  ],
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22.6.0",
    "dsh": ">=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./agent/dsh-plugin.mjs",
    "./client": "./agent/dsh-client.js",
    "./locale/en.json": "./skills/oneclickvirt-ecs/en.json",
    "./locale/zh.json": "./skills/oneclickvirt-ecs/zh.json",
    "./icon": "./agent/dsh-icon.svg"
  },
  "bin": {
    "goecs-dsh": "scripts/goecs_dsh.mjs"
  },
  "files": [
    "agent/dsh-plugin.mjs",
    "agent/dsh-service.mjs",
    "agent/dsh-platform.mjs",
    "agent/dsh-engine.mjs",
    "agent/dsh-process.mjs",
    "agent/dsh-ssh.mjs",
    "agent/dsh-report.mjs",
    "agent/dsh-options.mjs",
    "agent/dsh-client.js",
    "skills/oneclickvirt-ecs/en.json",
    "skills/oneclickvirt-ecs/zh.json",
    "agent/vendor/ssh2",
    "agent/dsh-icon.svg",
    "agent/dsh.patch.yml",
    "scripts/goecs_dsh.mjs",
    "scripts/check_dsh_plugin.mjs",
    "scripts/build_dsh_client.mjs",
    "README.md",
    "README_ZH.md",
    "LICENSE"
  ],
  "scripts": {
    "build": "node scripts/build_dsh_client.mjs",
    "test": "node --test agent/dsh-report.test.mjs agent/dsh-runtime.test.mjs agent/dsh-client.test.mjs",
    "check": "node scripts/check_dsh_plugin.mjs",
    "prepack": "npm run check"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@lydell/node-pty": "1.2.0-beta.18",
    "asn1": "0.2.6",
    "bcrypt-pbkdf": "1.0.2",
    "fflate": "0.8.3",
    "https-proxy-agent": "7.0.6",
    "socks-proxy-agent": "8.0.5"
  },
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "bundle": {
      "patch": "./agent/dsh.patch.yml",
      "platforms": [
        "darwin",
        "linux",
        "win32"
      ]
    },
    "client": {
      "platform": "web",
      "immediately": true,
      "inject": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale"
      ]
    }
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "jsdom": "26.1.0",
    "react": "19.3.1",
    "react-dom": "19.3.1"
  }
}
